title: UroAgent: multi-agent decision support for overactive bladder, bladder pain syndrome and urinary tract infection (research demonstrator)
description:
UroAgent is an open-source research demonstrator of a trustworthy multi-agent AI tool for overactive bladder (OAB), bladder pain syndrome (BPS) and urinary tract infection (UTI). A LangGraph state graph coordinates triage, deterministic red-flag and scope rules, a soft-voting machine learning ensemble with a confidence gate and SHAP explanations, hybrid guideline retrieval, symptom scoring and explanation. It provides a patient symptom assistant, a clinician agent with memory, imaging and report analysis, a score calculator, Model Context Protocol clinical tools and a built-in evaluation of acceptance targets and fairness.

Research demonstrator only: synthetic data, not a medical device. Every recommendation needs clinician review.
